items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: I met my band director. He was amazingly great. And if it wasn’t for him you know I don’t know if I would have got through high school you know.

ctx.x: And this is a coke I have.

Yeah. So I met my band director. He was amazingly great. And if it wasn’t for him you know I don’t know if I would have got through high school you know. Besides, I’m like a Hall of Fame member of my high school. I’m in the Hall of Honors and everything like that, because of guys like him. He knew what I was doing, you know. So the next day I hear, “Alan Chez please report to Mr. DeNicola’s office.” And I’m like oh I’m going to get in trouble. I was in there, I was drinking. He comes in and he says, “Alan” he’s…
Now most high school students who are serious about music they now go the Berklee/ Manhattan School, they go that route. Did you not have to do that, or choose not to?
